ننقضي (form VII)
# نَنْقَضِي (nanqaḍī) /nan.qa.dˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
# نَنْقَضِيَ (nanqaḍiya) /nan.qa.dˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
